runscript.name: REQ-003 gearbox GetSteadyState() verification
runscript.description:
Throwaway regression script for the REQ-003 review fixes.
aircraft/gearbox_test is a two-electric-engine helicopter whose main rotor is driven by a single FGGearbox (main-gearbox) combining both engines onto one shared FGRotor thruster. Setting propulsion/set-running to -1 triggers FGPropulsion::InitRunning(-1), which calls FGPropulsion::SetEngineRunning() for both engines and then FGPropulsion::GetSteadyState() -- the function fixed for MAJOR #1 in the REQ-003 review (it previously summed the shared thruster's forces/ moments once per feeding engine, double-counting them, and never called FGGearbox::Calculate() so the shared thruster's thrust never advanced and the loop falsely reported "steady" immediately).
Notified properties let a human/CI compare against hand-computed expectations: with both engines running at full throttle (1500 HP each, symmetric gearbox channels), the shaft should spin up under combined torque, output-torque-lbft should be equal and non-zero for both engine channels (shared load, not double-applied), and the gearbox's shared rotor thrust must NOT be double the single-shared- thruster value (there is exactly one physical rotor).
